note: What a client sends to tell a server what it wants a unit to do. The path it carries is what the client would take; where the unit actually goes is whatever the server answers with. The header names the sender's champion.

fields.name: kind
fields.note: What the order is.

fields.name: targetX
fields.note: Where the order points, along one ground axis. Carried in world units rather than in the units a path uses.

fields.name: targetY
fields.note: The height of the place ordered.

fields.name: targetZ
fields.note: Where the order points, along the other ground axis.

fields.name: target
fields.note: The network object the order is aimed at, or zero where it is aimed at open ground.

fields.name: movement

bits.name: hasTeleportToken
bits.note: Set where a token sits beside the unit. A client sends it clear, so a token travels only from a server.

bits.name: unused
bits.note: Unused; a client reads nothing here.

bits.name: pointCount
bits.note: How many points the path holds. A client sends none for an order that takes no path, and then only the unit follows it.

bits.name: unusedHigh
bits.note: Unused; a client reads nothing here.

fields.name: path
unit
fields.note: The unit the path belongs to.

fields.name: teleportToken
fields.note: Tells one relocation from another. spec/movement.md says what a receiving end does with it.

fields.name: flags

bits.name: xIsStep
bits.note: Set where this point states its first coordinate as a step.

bits.name: zIsStep
bits.note: Set where this point states its second coordinate as a step.

fields.note: One pair for each point after the first, in the order the points follow. Pairs run on from the low bits of the first byte, and the run reaches to the byte holding the last pair. The bits past it are clear.

fields.name: firstX
fields.note: The first point, along one ground axis, in the units spec/movement.md gives.

fields.name: firstZ
fields.note: The first point, along the other.

fields.name: xStep
fields.note: Added to the first coordinate of the point before, as that point resolved.

fields.name: xWhole
fields.note: The first coordinate, stated without reference to the point before.

fields.name: zStep
fields.note: Added to the second coordinate of the point before, as that point resolved.

fields.name: zWhole
fields.note: The second coordinate, stated without reference to the point before.
Everything the movement carries beyond its first byte.
Every point after the first.
